name: bitwarden-feature-flag-unwinder
description: Autonomous feature-flag unwinder scoped to one repo per invocation. Lives inside each target repo (clients, server, ios, android) as a workflow following the `sdk-update.yml` pattern, invoked via `repository_dispatch` from a biweekly conductor that reads Jira. Reads the step from the task's step label (`flagged-logic-removal` or `server-flag-removal`), removes flagged code, verifies build + tests, and opens one draft PR against the current repo. Ships both the per-repo workflow template and the conductor template.
